interface_base.consistency_and_reverse_l.desc: who_depends_on 反查、check_consistency 五类图违规与 render_tree 树渲染；目标根缺少 .gbc 时 check_consistency 必须响亮失败，现存空 .gbc 才可视为空一致图，杜绝未检查却假绿。

interface_base.refactor_suite_rewrites_g.desc: refactor_file/refactor_func/rename_guarantee 三件套正确重写全图引用(path前缀重映射、symbol改写、保证id改名且自动disable)、保持id不变、覆盖幂等场景与报错路径

interface_base.crud_wraps_disk_and_bound.desc: 保证 CRUD 包装层（create/disable/enable/update/retire_guarantee）的承诺：真的落盘到 .gbc/<path>/gbc.<name>.json 并可被 list_provides 读回；路径越界（跳出当前项目根）拒绝并抛 IllegalFilePathError；核心层异常（MetaNotFoundError/GuaranteeNotFoundError/GuaranteeDuplicatedError/GuaranteeHasDependentsError/GuaranteeTestFailedError）正确穿透 meta_session 传播；改非 runner 字段（heavy/timeout_override）不触发门禁重跑但仍落盘。

interface_base.dependency_bookkeeping_pe.desc: add/remove_dependency 包装层真实双向落盘；正常删除保持 symbol 语义；consumer meta 已丢失时仅允许明确 gid 且 provider 反向边确含 consumer 的 provider-only 清理，不重建空 consumer meta，清理后一致性恢复。

render_tree.scoped_views.desc: Scoped folder browsing honors relative depth, folder-only projection and fallback intent, validates paths, and limits gaps by subtree while checking references across the full graph.

render_tree_for.direct_contract_context.desc: Target files share deduplicated ancestor context and directly related named contracts while retaining target associations, tests, disabled status and consumers; missing registrations are explicit and invalid targets are rejected without test execution.

verify_all.strict_project_gate.desc: Strict project verification groups equivalent executor/selector/command/cwd/environment/effective-timeout plans once per call, fans success or failure to every referencing guarantee, and rejects disabled, missing or zero-result acceptance. Reports guarantee executed counts separately from unique test_runs.
